UI_options_QoLC_Features_Desc: Turn individual features on or off. Features with settings of their own have their switch in their own section below.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Hotbar_tooltip: Drag hotbar slots into the order you want, and click a slot to use it. Off restores the vanilla hotbar.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Flashlight_tool: Hang a torch off either belt slot, the way a screwdriver or a walkie talkie already can. Attaching one does not switch it on. Takes effect on the next start.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Capacity_toolti: Stops a container's name running into the weight printed beside it.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_XpView_tooltip: The skills panel says what a boost is really worth. Off restores the vanilla percentages, which understate it.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Generator_toolt: Adds how long the fuel lasts to the generator window, and highlights the squares it powers.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Material_toolti: Adds what a garment is made of to its tooltip, colored by fabric.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_TakeAmount_tool: Adds a typed amount to the grab menu, alongside vanilla's one, half and all.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FlagBook_toolti: Reads the first page of a book that is still too advanced, so a second copy is recognisable later.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_MoodleQuarters_: Squares off one more quarter of a moodle's plate for each level it climbs, so the stack reads at a glance. Stands down on its own if Moodle Quarters or Moodles in Lua is installed, since both replace the same panel.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_BookIcons_toolt: Gives all twenty four skill book families their own icon. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_AmmoIcons_toolt: Gives each ammo box and magazine its own icon. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FoodCategories_: Separates food that spoils from food that keeps in the inventory. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Desc: Enlarges the 3D character model on the in game info panel.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Enabled_too: Turn off to restore the vanilla avatar size. Takes effect immediately.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Desc: Full-screen tints that react to your moodles.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Enabled_tooltip: Turn off every moodle overlay. Each overlay still has its own strength slider below.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Desc: Shows how worn a weapon or tool is, without hovering it. Turns itself off if a mod that draws its own condition, such as Clean HotBar, is installed.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Enabled_toolti: Draws a bar under each equipped weapon and each item on the hotbar. Green while healthy, amber under half, red under a quarter.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Desc: Sort a container's duplicates by condition, how full they are, or what they are worth eating.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Enabled_tooltip: Adds the sort options to a container's right click menu. Off removes them and leaves the two settings below with nothing to do.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Speak_tooltip: The character mentions it rather than walking over to do nothing.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Extras_tooltip: Adds two more ways to sort clothing and weapons, at the cost of a longer menu.
